trends.name: Iran Ceasefire Fragility & Strait of Hormuz
trends.summary: Iran-Israel ceasefire is extremely fragile with conflicting reports on scope (Lebanon excluded per White House), tanker passage halted, and threats of withdrawal if Israeli attacks continue. Saudi oil pipeline hit by drone attack. Two-week uncertainty window creates volatility in energy markets and geopolitical risk premium.

trends.name: Oil Price Volatility & Energy Sector Rally
trends.summary: Oil prices initially plunged on ceasefire hopes but remain volatile as Hormuz uncertainty persists. Energy stocks rallying (Carnival +, airlines cutting growth due to fuel costs). Alcoa seeing geopolitical tailwinds. Refinery assets (Delta's $300M boost) becoming strategically valuable in uncertain supply environment.

trends.name: Fed Rate Cut Expectations Rising
trends.summary: Fed officials signal rate cuts likely this year despite geopolitical turmoil, per March meeting minutes. Markets shifting back toward dovish expectations after Iran ceasefire. Fed communications suggest flexibility on timing, though inflation concerns remain. Nick Timiraos notes ceasefire has already impacted rate path calculations.

trends.name: AI Competition Intensifying: Meta vs. OpenAI/Google
trends.summary: Meta debuts new AI model from superintelligence group to catch Google and OpenAI after billions in spending. Perplexity's revenue surges 50% monthly to $450M+ ARR after AI agents pivot, doubling quarterly revenue. AI arms race accelerating with major capex commitments driving sector valuations and competition for talent.

trends.name: Smart Money Rotating Out of AI Chip Bets
trends.summary: Sophisticated investors swapping risky concentrated bets on AI chip stocks for guaranteed payouts and diversified positions. Suggests peak enthusiasm in chip sector valuations and growing awareness of execution risks. Zscaler positioned as AI tailwind play at discount; ASML strong cash flow profile attractive.

trends.name: Defense & Palantir Sector Upgrade Cycle
trends.summary: Palantir rated upgrade as geopolitical tensions elevate defense spending priorities. 'Silicon Valley meets defense' narrative strengthening as Middle East tensions justify higher defense budgets. Geopolitical risk premium benefiting defense contractors and intelligence software providers.

trends.name: Healthcare Sector Pullback & Buying Opportunity
trends.summary: Healthcare stocks experiencing pullback creating entry opportunities. Eli Lilly positioned as buy on fundamentals. Mesoblast moving into DMD treatment space with speculative upgrade. Sector valuations becoming attractive after market weakness, healthcare dividend plays gaining traction.

trends.name: Inflation Persistence Despite Ceasefire
trends.summary: Inflation unlikely to slow significantly even with Iran ceasefire holding, challenging Fed's path to rate cuts. Supply chain disruptions from geopolitical tensions, energy costs, and broader macro pressures remain. Creates tension between rate cut expectations and inflation reality for markets.

trends.name: K-Shaped Economy & Widening Wealth Disparity
trends.summary: Main Street bankers terrified by K-shaped recovery with divergent outcomes between sectors and populations. Nostalgia for 1990s Goldilocks economy reflects anxiety over persistent inequality. Creates market bifurcation between beneficiaries of AI/tech and traditional sectors struggling with costs.

trends.name: Trump Administration Tariff & Trade Policy Uncertainty
trends.summary: Trump threatens new Iran tariffs with products facing potential hits. Spain's Sánchez pushes back on Trump's geopolitical interventions. Trade policy uncertainty continues to shape market expectations around energy, manufacturing, and cross-border commerce. Behind-closed-doors negotiations on ceasefire 'points' create additional uncertainty.

trends.name: Tech Sector Layoffs & Leadership Transitions
trends.summary: Microsoft's Julia Liuson retires after 34 years leading developer tools division; part of broader tech sector leadership churn. Reflects structural changes in tech organizational priorities and potential strategic shifts in developer-focused business units.

trends.name: Dividend & Value Stock Rotation Opportunity
trends.summary: Dividend-focused strategies gaining attention with DGRO, Sysco (Dividend King positioning), and sector rotation into value from growth. Attractive dividend yields in uncertain macro environment appeal to risk-averse investors. Globant, Repligen, and other names trading at attractive valuations with solid fundamentals.
